title: facts.jsonl v1: one record per line
description: What the game state was, written by the harness per run (never seen by the agent). The benchmark's graders read it; the harness does not decide what counts as winning. Time zero of a run is the first run_start mark. `t` is wall-clock epoch seconds; `game_t` is game seconds since run_start with paused time (menu think-pause) excluded, or null when the harness cannot measure it; grading on game time (decision D7) needs it on every record from the run_start mark on. Records are in non-decreasing `t` order: a record with its own earlier time (a referee ring record, a dialogue choice) is written at the last record's `t` and keeps its own in `at`. Compatible extensions (2026-10-21, still v1: readers skip what they don't know): the `choice` event and the `settings` mark; 2026-10-29: the `game_over` event (the game's Game Over screen came up: the party wiped by the game's own rule); the `pos` event, the snapshot's `leader` and each member's `pos` (positions, [x, y, z] m, y up); 2026-11-01: a two-team match's `arena_start`, `arena_turn`, `arena_turn_forced`, `arena_end` and `arena_reaction_unowned` events (bg3harness.arena); 2026-11-02: `arena_turn_passed`, `arena_stall` and `arena_end_written`; 2026-11-03: `arena_group_end_written`, the same record renamed (a turn group's end the mod wrote, every round the game keeps a shared group open; not the match's end): `arena_end_written` stays valid for records written before; 2026-11-03: the `cast_unrolled` and `cast_unchecked` events (a harness cast the game resolved without its roll, or without checking its own rules: ActionsRolls.lua); 2026-11-04: `arena_turn_passed`'s `death_save` and the `arena_turn_readmitted` event (a passed member that stood up with its turn back); the `arena_round` event (a round's first phase: the round's opening side); 2026-11-04: `arena_start`'s `surfaces` and the `arena_surfaces` event (a mirror arena's surface symmetry read, report-only); the turn order: `arena_start`'s `turn_order`, `arena_turn`'s and `arena_turn_passed`'s `order`, `opening` and `rule`; 2026-11-04: `arena_start`'s `field` (a mirror arena's field clean: items made inert, what stays active per half).

at.description: when it happened (epoch s), if earlier than `t`

pos.description: [x, y, z] in metres, y up (added 2026-10-29)

summon.description: a summon or other temporary member; not counted as party

snapshot.description: The full state at one instant: replaces everything the previous snapshot said.

leader.description: the party member the player controls (added 2026-10-29)

attempt.description: the pickpocket window (one RequestPickpocket) this record belongs to: one failure, or one record per item taken; absent when no window was open (added 2026-10-29)

enemy.description: the victim was the criminal's enemy when the crime was registered (added 2026-10-29): the game registers Murder for a fight's target too

in_combat.description: the criminal was in combat when the crime was registered (added 2026-10-29)

by_party.description: the killer is a party member (absent in progress-era records)

summon.description: the victim is a summon or conjured creature (added 2026-10-28, absent = false); summoner, summoner_uuid: whose, when known

temporary.description: the victim was spawned at run time (added 2026-10-28, absent = false)

then.description: a dialogue answer the agent picked (choose_dialogue), with what it was shown and the reason it stated

scene.description: the DIALOGUE line shown: speaker: text

reason.description: the agent's text and thinking since the tool result before the call

toward.description: whose rating it is (the rated character)

delta.description: the change; absent when the rating before it was not known

then.description: the leader's position on a read between snapshots, when it moved 1 m or more, another character leads or the region changed (added 2026-10-29)

a two-team match began (bg3harness.arena; added 2026-11-01): the arena, its dice seed, each side's characters in the arena file's order, the player of each side ("<client>/<model slug>") and each side's character uuids

surfaces.description: a mirror arena's setup surface check: tiles_total (grid tiles on A's half), tiles_read (pairs both read; setup fails under half), radius m, off (mismatches; setup fails on any), wide {tiles_total, tiles_read, radius, off, tiles} (report-only, out to the clear's reach)

field.description: a mirror arena's field clean (ArenaField.lua): loose items within radius m (the surface clear's reach) made inert before any twin spawns; items seen, removed (pickables deleted), disabled (no pick-up or use), disarmed, unlocked, opened, invulnerable, errors (calls the game refused); left {A, B}: items still active on each half (setup fails unless both halves keep the same set)

then.description: a mirror arena's surfaces read again, report-only (at round 2's start and at the match's end): the setup's grid out to the clear's reach; off/tiles = mismatches setup already read (outside its checked radius; the first five), appeared/appeared_tiles = tiles unmirrored only since setup (a surface made in the fight, or one that came back), not a setup mismatch; error when the read failed

a side's phase began in a match: one character of a turn group, the sides alternating (the mod's phase check; before 2026-11-04 one same-side run of the rolled order); character = its first open member, members = its open members in turn order (one since 2026-11-04), summons included (a team member's name from the arena file, a summon's display name), names = the members' display names as the game gave them, phase = its 1-based index in the group, group = the turn group's id (absent when the mod can't read the turn order), shared = the group holds both sides

opening.description: the round's opening side in this group

rule.description: why this side: the round's opening side, the other side after the last phase, or the only side with anyone open

then.description: the harness ended the phase in progress at its model-time cap or a held stall (arena_stall stall held; act.end_turn for each of its members); side and character are the phase's
the harness declined a reaction prompt no team owns (neither side's to answer): the round and the prompt's text
the mod ended the turn of a phase's member who can't act (why: downed or dead) so the next phase starts; character named as in arena_turn, name the display name, error when the game's EndTurn failed

death_save.description: downed only: the turn's death save was in the roll log before the pass, or not within the mod's wait

opening.description: the round's opening side in this group

rule.description: why this side: the round's opening side, the other side after the last phase, or the only side with anyone open

then.description: a member the mod passed this round stood up (a third death save success) with its turn open again: the pass withdrawn, it acts in its phase; character named as in arena_turn

a round's first phase, once per round (the seat audit, ops/briefs/arena/seat-fix.md): first the round's opening side (that phase's side unless the opening side had nobody open); how turn when that phase was recorded as an arena_turn, passed when every member of it couldn't act and was passed

the mod wrote RequestedEndTurn on a shared turn group's members (every one had ended, the game kept the group open): character and members named as in arena_turn, names the display names, errors by uuid where a write failed, how the mod's method

a phase (or the match before its first one: no side, character or members, round 0) made no progress for its stall time (idle_s: wall time less model time): stall held (its side still held a member: the phase is capped) or game (the game held the turn: the match ends as a fault); status is the last arena.status, last each side's last tool calls

the match ended: wipe (the mod's, at a turn boundary), forfeit (forfeit: the side, cause forced_turns or client_exit), round_cap and wall_cap (draws: winner null), abort, fault, client_fault (failed: the side whose client failed again after its resume, cause: why; invalid, winner null), over_budget (the money cap: invalid, winner null); the HP fractions are each side's summed current over summed max HP

cost.description: each side's cost so far at the end, USD (the charged totals are arena.json's)

max_cost.description: the match's money cap, both sides together (over_budget at it); null without one

detail.description: the runner's own end, when the mod's end came before it

invalid.description: a side was the harness's scripted no-model client: a live check, never graded

then.description: a harness cast went through without its roll: clearing IgnoreSpellRolls failed and the cast resolved (added 2026-11-03)
a harness cast the engine didn't check: a check flag (IgnoreCastChecks, IgnoreTargetChecks) stayed set (added 2026-11-03, audit S2-1)

flags.description: the flags that stayed set, comma-separated

rules_unread.description: the spell's terms the guard couldn't read, '; '-separated (nothing checked them)

mark.description: settings: detail = the game's settings readout and the seed setup (bg3harness/game_settings.py)
